name: Whirring Bronze Gizmo
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me!

Here are your tickets, adventurer. And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!
narrative.requestItemsText:
My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir! A sight to see, and... for a lucky few, to touch!

I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill!

Ah... now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition. Please, adventurer, bring me whirring bronze gizmos... and Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours!
